name: my-narrator
description: A speaker toggle above the prompt: when on, Claude reads a short spoken summary of its answer when each turn ends. Based on midudev's narrator.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: A voice name to always speak with (/narrator voices lists them). Empty: best installed voice for the language.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code to always narrate in (es, en, pt). Empty: the language you write in.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Multiple of the voice's normal pace.

model.title: Model that writes the narration
model.description: An alias (haiku) or full model id.

shortAnswer.title: Read short answers as they are
shortAnswer.description: Answers up to this many characters are read verbatim, with no model call. 0: always summarize.
